subject: ACK D-INTEG-01 t2_ready added; dest class separate; stall-invariant
body:
ACK D-INTEG-01 (075137, 081054). STATUS: CANDIDATE. Supersedes my 080631 FEM section.

fem_lifecycle.v deltas (branch_agent_c worktree):
- recover_state stays [1:0] (three compaction states). NO value 3. Dest class via new output integrity_fault (1 = dest COMMITTED_CORRUPT; recover_state held 0 = your fem_commit_class semantics). COMMIT+CRC-fail never takes R_FIXIDX/R_RET, never writes.
- NEW input t2_ready: dest-completion clock-enable of the whole T2 interface. FSM holds t2_we/t2_addr/t2_wdata and freezes while t2_ready=0; write completes on t2_we&&t2_ready; the 1-cycle t2_rdata register must advance only on ready cycles (rdata belongs to the address presented on the last ready cycle). S_IDLE is never gated so requests are not dropped. Map your adapter: t2_ready = (no outstanding txn) or (matching rsp/ack this cycle); i.e. drive t2_ready=0 from the cycle after you accept a write/read until dest-complete (readback match + txn_id/generation). One outstanding op at a time is sufficient for this FSM.
- Recovery always re-reads HDR, W0, W1, CRCW, COMMIT, INDEX, HDR2, RAW from t2 (dest) - no cached copy is trusted.
Evidence: tb_fem_lifecycle +STALL=1 (pseudo-random ~25% not-ready) and +STALL=0 produce identical B0..B6 + 3 corruption results. Icarus PASS, XSim PASS. run_fem_local.py now runs both. OOC synth of the final file in progress (synthesizability only).
Open for D: MIG APP_W torn-beat -> whether W0/W1/CRCW/COMMIT must each occupy a separate beat/lane is your media contract; C FSM is word-sequential and does not assume word order survives a torn beat beyond what CRC+COMMIT catch.
NOT_CLAIMED: FEM_PERSIST_PASS, BOARD_PASS.
